headline: Peru Fintech Sector Expands to 318 Companies, 93% Based in Lima
summary: A new study identified 318 active fintech companies in Peru across 12 subsectors. However, industry distribution remains heavily concentrated, with 93% of firms headquartered in the capital city of Lima.
why: Fintech development in Latin America expands access to financial services, payment networks, and digital credit across developing consumer markets.
